head: 1d3c541a3e16157d48852e86ce0fd09838e872d2
scope: Default PR CI plus six install repositories. SFW excluded because it is optional and unchanged.
controls: Identical product source and two shared browser port fixes, unchanged snapshot coverage.
Identical tool versions and runner labels.
Cold: no Cargo, SDK, pnpm, native or archive cache restore or save.
Warm: exact cache hits required, no saves, same immutable common caches.
New archive caches and new Cargo keys are primed separately. Cache IDs and versions recorded.
Zig global/local build caches disabled; compiler installation/download caches are uncontrolled.
Runner images, tool download caches, network services and allocation are uncontrolled.

runs.excluded_from_measurement: Overlaps the initial regular PR CI; retained as a calibration run. Exclusion chosen before candidate cold result.
Failed Windows command_owner_pnpm10 snapshot: npm cache copyfile EBUSY/EEXIST. Replace the complete run on unchanged source; do not combine a partial retry with original timings.

runs.comparison_note: Successful unpaired warm baseline. Its candidate run failed cache checks, so it supplies no before/after speed result.

runs.excluded_from_measurement: Six candidate cache entries disappeared before or during this run; exact-hit checks failed.

runs.purpose: Replace five evicted PR-side caches; excluded preparation.

benchmark_cache_cleanup: All remaining cache entries under refs/heads/bench/scheduling-2986-r2 were removed after audit. See benchmark-cache-cleanup.json; no main or production PR cache entries were manually removed.
comparison_note: Report one complete cold pair and one complete warm pair. The additional successful warm baseline is unpaired. Candidate exact-hit checks failed after cache loss; a repeat preflight then found six shared entries missing. Do not mix these attempts into a timing comparison.
